Meta-analysis
A random-effects meta-analysis with DerSimonian-Laird methods was performed using R software on the change of each outcome
(i.e. vitamin vs. placebo). Effects sizes are presented as standardized mean differences (SMD), mean differences (MD) or risk ratio
(RR) with means  SD and 95% CIs. Heterogeneity was assessed by c2 and I2 and signiﬁcance was set at p < 0.05. Additionally,
subgroup analysis (i.e. vitamin E vs. vitamin C, or trained vs. untrained) and meta-regression (length of the study) were performed.
